metric.net_revenue.label: Net revenue
metric.net_revenue.formula: Sum of the net amount of invoices that are not voided.
metric.net_revenue.convention: After every item discount, bill discount and voucher. Edited invoices count with their latest amount.
metric.invoices.label: Invoices
metric.invoices.formula: Number of invoices that are not voided.
metric.invoices.convention: An edited invoice still counts once.
metric.avg_ticket.label: Average ticket
metric.avg_ticket.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.avg_ticket.convention: No value while there are no invoices.
metric.items_per_ticket.label: Items per ticket
metric.items_per_ticket.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.items_per_ticket.convention: Modifier lines, services and combos do not count as items, so the average ticket = items per ticket × average item price.
metric.avg_item_price.label: Average item price
metric.avg_item_price.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.avg_item_price.convention: It uses the net revenue of whole invoices, so average item price × items per ticket equals the average ticket exactly.
metric.gross_revenue.label: Gross revenue
metric.gross_revenue.formula: Sum of the gross amount of invoices that are not voided, before every discount.
metric.gross_revenue.convention: It is the denominator of the discount rate.
metric.cash_share.label: Cash share
metric.cash_share.formula: Tenders of cash-kind payment methods ÷ all tenders.
metric.cash_share.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.cash_share.convention: The kind of each payment method comes from the POS catalogue; compared in percentage points.
metric.voucher_invoice_share.label: Voucher invoice share
metric.voucher_invoice_share.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.voucher_invoice_share.convention: An invoice has a voucher when it carries a voucher amount or a voucher code.
metric.member_invoice_share.label: Member invoice share
metric.member_invoice_share.formula: Invoices with a member phone number ÷ invoices.
metric.member_invoice_share.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.member_invoice_share.convention: Phone numbers only; 0 % means measured and no invoice had one.
metric.customer_capture_rate.label: Customer capture rate
metric.customer_capture_rate.formula: Invoices that identify the customer (phone or customer id) ÷ invoices.
metric.customer_capture_rate.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.customer_capture_rate.convention: Wider than the member invoice share because it also counts invoices with a customer id only.
metric.discount_rate.label: Discount rate
metric.discount_rate.formula: (Item discounts + bill discounts + vouchers) ÷ gross revenue.
metric.discount_rate.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.discount_rate.convention: The denominator is gross revenue, never net; compared in percentage points.
metric.peak_share_20_21.label: Peak-hour share (20:00–21:59)
metric.peak_share_20_21.formula: Net revenue from 20:00 to 21:59 ÷ net revenue of the day.
metric.peak_share_20_21.grain: Store-day; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.peak_share_20_21.convention: In the store's local time; compared in percentage points.
metric.weekday_share.label: Weekday share (one value per ISO weekday 1–7)
metric.weekday_share.formula: Net revenue of the weekday ÷ net revenue of the week.
metric.weekday_share.convention: Days of the week still to come have no value.
metric.same_weekday_baseline.label: Same-weekday baseline
metric.same_weekday_baseline.formula: Median of the same weekday over the previous 8 weeks; for today only invoices up to the same time count.
metric.same_weekday_baseline.grain: Day; several stores are summed per day before taking the median.
metric.same_weekday_baseline.convention: Holidays, Tết days and days without data are left out.
metric.forecast_weekday_profile.label: Weekday-profile forecast
metric.forecast_weekday_profile.formula: Mean daily net of 28 days × the weekday index of 84 days.
metric.forecast_weekday_profile.conventi: Holidays and Tết days are left out of both parts; a reference forecast, not a target.
metric.forecast_seasonal_naive.label: Seasonal-naïve forecast
metric.forecast_seasonal_naive.formula: Net revenue of the latest day with sales on the same weekday.
metric.forecast_seasonal_naive.conventio: Holidays are not left out; it is the simplest reference forecast.
metric.forecast_mae.label: Forecast mean absolute error
metric.forecast_mae.formula: Mean of |actual − forecast| over recent days, each forecast one day ahead.
metric.forecast_mae.convention: Only days with sales, not holidays, and with both forecasts count, so the two methods compare like for like.
metric.item_velocity.label: Item velocity
metric.item_velocity.formula: (Quantity of the latest 28 days − quantity of the 28 days before) ÷ the earlier quantity.
metric.item_velocity.grain: Item-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.item_velocity.convention: Only items with enough quantity in both windows are ranked.
metric.size_l_share.label: Size L share
metric.size_l_share.formula: Quantity of size L items ÷ quantity of all sized items.
metric.size_l_share.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.size_l_share.convention: No value while no sized item has been sold.
metric.attach_rate_topping.label: Topping attach rate
metric.attach_rate_topping.formula: Invoices with a drink and a topping ÷ invoices with a drink.
metric.attach_rate_topping.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.attach_rate_topping.convention: Needs item-type roles; without them it is not measured.
metric.attach_rate_snack.label: Snack attach rate
metric.attach_rate_snack.formula: Invoices with a drink and a snack ÷ invoices with a drink.
metric.attach_rate_snack.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.attach_rate_snack.convention: Needs item-type roles; without them it is not measured.
metric.cash_variance.label: Cash variance
metric.cash_variance.formula: Counted drawer − expected cash (opening float + cash tenders of the shift).
metric.cash_variance.convention: Cash payouts are not synced from the POS, so a payout during the shift shows as a shortage.
metric.cash_variance_zscore.label: Cash variance z-score
metric.cash_variance_zscore.formula: (Variance − mean variance of the store's shifts in the previous 56 days) ÷ their standard deviation.
metric.cash_variance_zscore.convention: Needs at least 3 earlier shifts; a shift is flagged over 2, or over the absolute 50,000 VND or relative 0.5 % of cash sales thresholds.
metric.hourly_net.label: Net revenue by hour
metric.hourly_net.formula: Sum of the net amount by hour of sale, in the store's local time.
metric.hourly_net.convention: The hourly baseline is the median of the same hour on the same weekday over the previous 8 weeks, whole days.
metric.item_net.label: Item revenue
metric.item_net.formula: Sum of the net amount of item lines on invoices that are not voided.
metric.item_net.convention: Modifier lines (sugar, ice), services and combos do not count as items.
metric.cash_to_count.label: Cash to count
metric.cash_to_count.formula: Sum of the tenders whose payment method is of the cash kind.
metric.cash_to_count.convention: Excludes the opening float; reconcile with the drawer in the shift report.
metric.discount_cost.label: Discount cost
metric.discount_cost.formula: Item discounts + bill discounts + vouchers of invoices that are not voided.
metric.discount_cost.convention: It is the money given away, not the extra revenue a promotion brought.
metric.flagged_shifts.label: Flagged shifts
metric.flagged_shifts.formula: Shifts whose drawer variance is over the absolute, relative or z-score threshold.
metric.flagged_shifts.convention: Shifts without a counted drawer are not scored.
metric.weekday_net.label: Net revenue by weekday
metric.weekday_net.formula: Net revenue of each day of the week.
metric.weekday_net.convention: Compared with the same day of last week and the 4-week average.
metric.category_net_share.label: Category share of item revenue
metric.category_net_share.formula: Item revenue of the category ÷ item revenue of every category.
metric.category_net_share.grain: Category-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.category_net_share.convention: Items without a category are grouped as "Uncategorised".
metric.daily_net.label: Daily net revenue
metric.daily_net.formula: Net revenue of each day of the period.
metric.daily_net.convention: Closed days have no revenue; holidays are marked.
metric.item_pareto_count.label: Items making 80 % of item revenue
metric.item_pareto_count.formula: The fewest items, ranked by revenue, that add up to 80 % of item revenue.
metric.item_pareto_count.grain: Period; several stores are summed first.
metric.item_pareto_count.convention: The smaller the number, the more revenue rests on few items.
metric.new_item_count.label: New items
metric.new_item_count.formula: Items first sold in the period.
metric.new_item_count.grain: Item-period; several stores are summed first.
metric.new_item_count.convention: The first sale is taken over the whole history of the selected stores.
metric.target_progress.label: Target progress
metric.target_progress.formula: Month-to-date net revenue ÷ the monthly target.
metric.target_progress.grain: Store-month; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.target_progress.convention: Needs a target for every selected store; otherwise it is not computed.
metric.month_year_net.label: Monthly net revenue by year
metric.month_year_net.formula: Net revenue of each month, one row per year.
metric.month_year_net.convention: A month still running is marked as partial.
metric.seasonality_index.label: Seasonality index
metric.seasonality_index.formula: Average daily net revenue of the month ÷ the mean over 12 complete months.
metric.seasonality_index.grain: Month; only stores with all 12 months count.
metric.seasonality_index.convention: Above 1 is a stronger month than usual; needs 12 months of data.
metric.item_lifecycle_count.label: Items by lifecycle status
metric.item_lifecycle_count.formula: Items by status: new, growing, steady, declining, discontinued.
metric.item_lifecycle_count.grain: Item-year; several stores are summed first.
metric.item_lifecycle_count.convention: Discontinued after 56 days without a sale; growing or declining when the year-to-date quantity moves 20 % or more against last year.
metric.since_opening_net.label: Net revenue since opening
metric.since_opening_net.formula: Average daily net revenue of each week since opening.
metric.since_opening_net.convention: For young stores that have no data from last year yet.
metric.sales_per_opening_hour.label: Sales per opening hour
metric.sales_per_opening_hour.formula: Net revenue ÷ opening hours of the days with sales.
metric.sales_per_opening_hour.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.sales_per_opening_hour.convention: Opening hours come from Settings → Store; overnight and split spans count. Without opening hours there is no value.
metric.invoices_per_opening_hour.label: Invoices per opening hour
metric.invoices_per_opening_hour.formula: Invoices ÷ opening hours of the days with sales.
metric.invoices_per_opening_hour.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.invoices_per_opening_hour.convent: Uses the same opening hours as sales per opening hour.
metric.revpash.label: Revenue per available seat hour
metric.revpash.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.revpash.convention: Needs the seat count of every store with sales; without it there is no value.
metric.peak_share_top_hours.label: Peak-hour share (top hours)
metric.peak_share_top_hours.formula: Revenue of the best-selling hours ÷ revenue of the range.
metric.peak_share_top_hours.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.peak_share_top_hours.convention: The number of peak hours comes from Settings → Report thresholds (3 by default); compared in percentage points.
metric.dead_hour_share.label: Quiet-hour share
metric.dead_hour_share.formula: Revenue of the hours below the quiet level ÷ revenue of the range.
metric.dead_hour_share.grain: Store-period; several stores are summed before dividing.
metric.dead_hour_share.convention: An hour is quiet when its mean revenue is below the quiet ratio (0.5 by default) times the mean hour of the open span.
metric.moving_average_net.label: Moving average of revenue
metric.moving_average_net.formula: Mean net revenue of the last 7 days (or 4 weeks) at each point.
metric.moving_average_net.grain: Day for ranges up to 92 days, week beyond.
metric.moving_average_net.convention: Only days or weeks with sales count; Tết is shaded.
metric.month_net.label: Revenue by month
metric.month_net.formula: Net revenue of each month in the range.
metric.month_net.convention: The first and last months may be partial; compared with the same month last year on the same stores.
metric.store_net_share.label: Share of each store
metric.store_net_share.formula: Net revenue of the store ÷ net revenue of all selected stores.
metric.store_net_share.convention: Compared with the previous range in percentage points.
metric.hour_heat.label: Revenue by hour and weekday
metric.hour_heat.formula: Net revenue of each hour × weekday cell ÷ days of that weekday with sales.
metric.hour_heat.grain: Hour × weekday; several stores are summed.
metric.hour_heat.convention: Hours are local, starting at the business-day start.
metric.busy_window.label: Busy window
metric.busy_window.formula: Consecutive hours whose invoices per day reach the busy ratio (1.25 by default) times the mean hour.
metric.busy_window.grain: Day group: Monday to Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
